_comment: The bots a host offers a seat to, in the order they are offered: what the journal measured as worth playing against (docs/learning/journal.md). Every other weights file directly under learning/weights/ is offered after these, by its name, as a heuristic; a set for another reading lives in a folder of its own (learning/weights/lookahead/) so it is not. The lobby and the pilot read this through the host, so a new search lands here and nowhere in a page.
